item.title: Why a look back at the ‘Me Too’ movement elicits mixed reactions in women
item.description: The origin of the ‘Me Too’ movement dates back to 2006, when US activist Tarana Burke coined the term. It was in 2017, however, that it caught on, following revelations about film producer Harvey Weinstein. In India, while the campaign allowed women the relief of expression, the accused have since been rehabilitated, while the complainants continue to be viewed through the lens of '#MeToo'.
